_how: Which skills each unit has, in slot order (keys Q W E R; up to 4). Keys are unit types: Warlord, Matron, Marshal (generals), Beetle, StagBeetle, Spider, Wasp (wild bugs and bosses), or any other unit type. 'Type@team' gives one colony its own: Warlord@0 is the black colony's, Warlord@1 the red colony's (later colonies: @2 and up). A general with four skills has its ultimate in the last slot (R, ranks at levels 6, 8, 10). A general learns its first skill at hatching and spends one point per level. Bugs use rank 1 and grow with their level.
